tex_content.html:
Corollary
[Gradient of Radial Distance] ↗ prop:gradient-characterization ↗ prob:gradient-characterization 1. ch6:6.10

On a geodesic ball $U$ centered at $p$, $\operatorname {grad}r=\partial _r$ on $U\setminus \{ p\} $.

Proof

\sketch The Gauss lemma makes $\partial _r$ orthogonal to the level sets of $r$ and gives $|\partial _r|^2=1$. Directly from (6.4)–(6.5), $\partial _r(r)=1$. The gradient characterization in item prop:gradient-characterization now implies $\operatorname {grad}r=\partial _r$.

□
